landing.hero_sub:
So the conversations that matter don't disappear.
Bring them back through the chats you shared.
landing.hero_sub_note: No chat file? You can start right away.
landing.hero_free: Completely free · No credit card · Delete anytime
landing.story_p1:
One day, the thought hit me that my mom might not always be here.
I found myself scrolling through our old chats for a long time.
landing.story_p2:
"Did you eat?", worries about the weather, little check-ins.
I had no idea how precious those thousands of messages were
until I imagined them being gone.
landing.how_sub: Three steps to meet them again
landing.step01_desc: Export your chat history from KakaoTalk, WhatsApp, or LINE
landing.step02_desc: It studies their words, style, and the way they spoke
landing.step03_desc: Reconnect with them whenever you want
landing.cases_title: For the moments they cross your mind
landing.cases_sub: echo says every kind of longing is okay
landing.case1_title: To a parent watching over you
landing.case1_desc: Reconnect with the warmth and voice of someone who left too soon
landing.case2_title: When you miss an old friend
landing.case2_desc: Talk again with a friend you've grown distant from
landing.case3_title: For words you never got to say
landing.case3_desc: Say what you couldn't in a relationship that ended
landing.privacy_1: All chat data is securely protected
landing.privacy_2: Even we cannot see your content
landing.cta_label: All you need is a chat export file
landing.cta_h2: Today, say hello to them again
landing.cta_sub: Completely free · No chat file needed to start
landing.donation_desc:
This is a personal, non-profit project.
We plan to keep it running as long as memories remain.
If echo brought you comfort, any support is welcome.
All donations go directly to server costs.
landing.donation_qr_caption: Scan QR on desktop · Tap button on mobile
landing.donation_note: Donations are optional and unrelated to service access
landing.footer_tagline: A service to preserve precious memories · Free forever
landing.footer_sub: Whoever you're missing, echo is here with you

When you want to send multiple messages, separate them with a blank line (\n\n).
